stages.reference: Create a close material reference for frost-covered ice near the final point of structural failure. This is still the same old translucent blue-gray sheet from the preceding three stages, but pressure cracks have multiplied, joined and enclosed uneven weakened plates. Milky stressed zones gather at intersections while broad remaining ice regions retain soft glacial depth. Fine frosted abrasion and trapped-air clouds should connect the image to its earlier states. Express imminent collapse through the density and branching of real-looking internal fractures, not through violent movement or extreme contrasts. Avoid scattered flying pieces, dramatic white or black line art, hard geometric polygons, excessive snow, glitter or glossy photographic crystal. Keep all fracture marks subdued within a single physically coherent ice body.
